name: chemical-review
description: Four composable, evidence-governed skills for critical narrative chemical literature reviews.

interface.shortDescription: Iteratively develop a critical chemical literature review.
interface.longDescription: A lightweight set of four composable Markdown-first skills for shaping, researching, drafting, and discussing a critical chemical literature review. The researcher keeps scientific judgement; the plugin does not claim validity or journal acceptance.
defaultPrompt: Use $chemical-review-intent to define and confirm a chemistry review brief.
Use $chemical-review-research with its preflight, discovery, and evidence Markdown companions to make the evidence route visible.
Use $chemical-review-synthesis and $chemical-review-qa to discuss one draft, independent observations, and the next revision in Markdown.
